title: Operation accepted
description: Answer of a changing operation without its own answer form: the change is recorded, a created object has an id, the audit record of the operation has the number audit_seq (AUD-1). A repeat with the same arguments gives the same answer (IDM-3).

id.description: Id of the created or changed object, if there is one.

audit_seq.description: Number of the operation's audit record in the tenant chain.

state.description: State of the object after the operation, if the object has one.

operator_steps.description: From v0.2: steps the operator does outside the farm after the operation, as codes; provider_key_revoke after tenant.offboard: revoke the tenant's key and workspace at the model provider, which needs an organization admin key the core does not hold (LCY-1, D-103).
